title: Crimson Mage Origin
description: The Crimson Mage Origin by Zyxey, part of Zyxey's Mythical Origins series.
body:
# Crimson Mage Origin
## Made by Zyxey

**Begin your journey as the mystical Crimson Mage, a wizard with the power to wield fire and explosion magic! Starting in the Nether, you will meet many powerful foes but through determination and your Origin powers you can pull through!**

**And speaking of Origin powers...**

✚🔥 **Pyro Blast:** Using your fire magic, you can use a free hand to cast forth a flurry of burning flames. (Trigger with Primary Button)

✚🧨 **Combustion Beam:** Using your explosion magic, you can cast a beam that will explode on impact. (Trigger with Secondary Button)

✚☀️ **Fireproof:** You have control over the element of fire, meaning you are unable to take fire damage or be set on fire.

✚💥 **Explosion Immune:** Having mastered the art of explosion magic, you no longer take damage from any form of explosion.

✚🌋 **One With Lava**: Your biology has adapted to lava, letting you swim through it without taking damage just as other organisms can swim through water.

✚🧙‍♂️ **Magic Resistant**: Your affinity with magic gives you the ability to take reduced magic damage.

━💣 **Failsafe Spell:** You have put an explosive curse on yourself which will blow up and incinerate everything and everyone near you on death, triggered by the action of your soul leaving your body.

━🍄 **Crimson Abode:** You spawn in the Crimson Forest biome.

✘🌊 **Water Vulnerability:** You constantly take damage when in water or rain.



### Origin Credit: Zyxey (me)
